entries.english:
...You have done very well. Together, you and Torneko have saved the people of this land.
I am the Earth God, who once led the people to the land of Barinabo.
Through your efforts, the evil will has been destroyed. The people of Barinabo have fulfilled their duty to watch over this world.
Accept this token of my gratitude. I shall send you the people of the earth, heirs to divine power.
